method.summary: Archive member names are associated with source files selected by the pinned NDK LLVM CMake rules. GNU ar member hashes bind the mapping to the exact local NDK archives.
method.compilerRtSelection: CMake GENERIC_SOURCES + GENERIC_TF_SOURCES + aarch64_SOURCES, Android conditional sources, and filter_builtin_sources duplicate-source rules.
method.outlineAtomics: The 125 outline_atomic_* objects are generated by the pinned CMake loop as symlink/copy variants of aarch64/lse.S with pattern, size, and model compile definitions.
limits: The NDK package does not provide per-member compile commands or source-object manifests; source associations are reconstructed from exact member labels and pinned build rules.
Configure-time compiler-rt branches are inferred from archive member presence when the packaged NDK omits its CMake cache.
This mapping does not reproduce object code or prove all compiler flags, toolchain patches, package provenance, license obligations, or legal approval.
The Node build tree's compiler include-input closure is recorded separately; this file maps only the two implicit NDK archives.
